burp_dashboard_issue.name: Cross-site request forgery
burp_dashboard_issue.detail: Profile email update lacks anti-CSRF protection.

advisory.analysis: The account email change workflow appears to be missing a request-origin protection control.
advisory.primary_next_action: Confirm one low-risk state change with a benign email update on a test account.
questions_for_user: Which other state-changing workflows reuse the same missing control?
confirmation_playbooks: Capture one same-session baseline and one forged variant on a test account.
impact_paths: Account profile changes can be triggered without anti-CSRF protection.

evidence.summary: Observed state-changing request without a CSRF token
The same request succeeds without an origin-bound control
